in_marathi.name: Charithraa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charithraa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Charithraa is derived from the Sanskrit word 'charithra' which means 'story' or 'account'. This name is often given to girls whose parents wish for them to have a life filled with interesting experiences and stories. In Hindu mythology, Charithraa is also the name of a celestial nymph who embodies the essence of storytelling and creativity.
